title: A Day in the City
description: Four recordings about a day in a big city: a tourist office, a bus tour, a café chat and a voicemail.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At the tourist office
parts.intro: You will hear a visitor, Emma, talking to a man at the tourist office.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Good morning. I'd like to visit the City Museum today. Is it far from here?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Not really. You can take bus number twelve from the stop outside. It takes about fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Great. What time does the museum open?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It opens at nine o'clock... no, wait. On Mondays it opens at ten. Today is Monday, so you have to wait an hour.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: That's fine. I can have a coffee first. How much is a ticket?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Adults pay eight pounds, but students only pay four. Do you have a student card?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Yes, I do! Thank you. Is there a good place for lunch near the museum?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Try the café opposite the park. The soup is lovely.

parts.title: Part 2 · On the tour bus
parts.intro: You will hear a guide talking to passengers on a city tour bus.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Welcome aboard, everyone. I'm Ms Clark, and I'll show you the best of our city today. The tour takes two hours.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: First, we will pass the old City Hall. It's more than two hundred years old, and its clock is famous.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Then we will cross the river on the blue bridge. If you look left, you can see the boats.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: After that, we will stop at the market for twenty minutes. You can buy fruit, flowers and little presents there.

script.speaker: Ms Clark
script.text: Please be back on the bus at eleven fifteen. We can't wait for anyone. Finally, we will drive through the big park. Enjoy the tour!

parts.title: Part 3 · Planning the afternoon
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and Mai in a café in the city.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: What shall we do this afternoon, Mai? We could go shopping.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I don't really want to, because I bought new shoes yesterday. How about the park?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I looked at the weather on my phone. It's going to rain after lunch.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh dear. Then let's go to the cinema. There's a funny film about a talking dog.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Good idea. What time does it start?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: There's one at two o'clock and another at four o'clock. We'll have time to finish our lunch, so let's go to the later one.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: OK. I'll buy the tickets on my phone now.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thanks. And afterwards, let's walk to the river, if the rain stops.

parts.title: Part 4 · A voicemail from Uncle Hai
parts.intro: You will hear a voicemail message from Linh's uncle.

script.speaker: Uncle Hai
script.text: Hello, Linh, it's Uncle Hai. I'm in the city already, and I can't wait to see you this evening!

script.speaker: Uncle Hai
script.text: Let's meet outside the railway station at six o'clock. I'll be near the big fountain.

script.speaker: Uncle Hai
script.text: I know a great noodle restaurant on Green Street. It's not expensive, and the owner is a friend of mine.

script.speaker: Uncle Hai
script.text: After dinner, we could walk by the river and look at the lights. The bridges are beautiful at night.

script.speaker: Uncle Hai
script.text: Your train home leaves at nine o'clock, so please bring your ticket. Call me if you are late. Bye for now!
